response.justification: The candidate brings genuine geospatial experience (founder of GISCollective, work with Green Map, FOSS4G speaker) and has built high-throughput, low-latency backend systems in DLang at Sociomantic, which demonstrates systems-level thinking relevant to routing pipelines. However, modern C++ exposure is limited to a brief 2014–2015 stint, recent years have been dominated by TypeScript/Node full-stack product work, and there is no evidence of navigation guidance, routing algorithms, or map-tile pipeline experience. The profile is adjacent to the role but misses its core technical requirements, so an interview is only warranted if the pipeline lacks stronger C++/navigation candidates.
strengths: Real geospatial domain experience via GISCollective and Green Map GIS applications
Low-latency, high-throughput systems work in DLang (async I/O, fibers, caching) at Sociomantic
Broad stack versatility, strong testing culture, and demonstrated willingness to learn new domains
concerns: Very limited and dated commercial C++ experience; no Rust; DLang is only an approximate substitute
No experience with routing engines, navigation guidance, or map-tile generation pipelines
Recent roles (2020–present) are TypeScript/Node product and web work, far from systems engineering
